mode.label: Resize by
mode.desc: How the new size is computed for each image.

percent.label: Scale
percent.desc: Both sides are scaled by this percentage; the aspect ratio is always kept.

longestSide.label: Longest side
longestSide.desc: The longer side of each image becomes this many pixels.

keepAspect.label: Keep aspect ratio
keepAspect.desc: On: the other side follows proportionally (exact size fits inside the box). Off: it is stretched or left unchanged.

snap.label: Snap after resize
snap.desc: Rounds each side to the nearest multiple of 4 or power of two (the image is resampled to that size, not padded).

filter.label: Filter
filter.desc: Nearest keeps pixel art crisp; Lanczos3 is the sharpest for photos and painted textures.

linearSpace.label: Resize in linear light
linearSpace.desc: Blends colors in linear space for more accurate brightness. Leave off for data maps (normal, roughness, masks).

premultiplyAlpha.label: Premultiplied alpha
premultiplyAlpha.desc: Prevents dark or colored fringes around transparent edges.

imageOps.noFile: Add images to see a live preview.
imageOps.invalidParams: Fix the highlighted parameters to see a preview.

sizes.title: Output sizes
sizes.empty: Add images to see their output sizes.
